qa_pairs.instruction: How do you run the configuration script to modify the initial configuration of the Fan-Out driver platform services?
qa_pairs.output:
To modify the initial configuration of the Fan-Out driver platform services, execute the following command on the server where the services are installed:
```
/usr/local/ASAM/bin/PlatformServices/plat-config
```

qa_pairs.instruction: What is the file system path of the configuration script used for the Fan-Out driver platform services?
qa_pairs.output:
The configuration script for the Fan-Out driver platform services is located at:
```
/usr/local/ASAM/bin/PlatformServices/plat-config
```

qa_pairs.instruction: Which configuration topics are available when you run the platform services configuration for the Fan-Out driver?
qa_pairs.output:
When you run the platform services configuration for the Fan-Out driver, the following topics can be configured:
- Platform Certificate Management
- Provisioning
- Authentication
- Password Changes

qa_pairs.instruction: Where can you find additional technical notes for the Fan-Out driver platform services configuration topics?
qa_pairs.output: Additional details about the platform services configuration topics for the Fan-Out driver are documented in Section B.0, Platform Services Technical Notes.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize how to reconfigure the Fan-Out driver platform services after the initial installation.
qa_pairs.output: After installing and initially configuring Platform Services for the Fan-Out driver, you can reconfigure any setting at any time by running the script `/usr/local/ASAM/bin/PlatformServices/plat-config`. The script will present options for Platform Certificate Management, Provisioning, Authentication, and Password Changes, and further details are available in Section B.0 of the Platform Services Technical Notes.
